SELECT VBS.BOOKSET_ID, VBS.SUBJECT_NO, VBS.FSUBJECT_ID, VBS.SUBJECT_LEVEL, VBS.BAL_FLAG FROM BOK_SUBJECT VBS
WHERE VBS.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT VBB.BOOKSET_ID, VBB.SUBJECT_NO, CASE WHEN VBB.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '99' THEN VBBD.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NAME ELSE VBS.SUBJECT_NAME END AS SUBJECT_NAME, VBB.O_CCY, VBB.BAL_FLAG, VBB.O_AMT, VBB.O_C_AMT, VBB.O_D_AMT, VBB.B_CCY, VBB.B_AMT, VBB.B_C_AMT, VBB.B_D_AMT FROM BOK_BALANCE VBB LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON VBB.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT VBS ON C.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = VBS.BOOKSET_ID AND VBB.SUBJECT_NO = VBS.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BUSS_DETSUB VBBD ON VBBD.BOOKSET_ID = VBB.BOOKSET_ID AND VBBD.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO = VBB.SUBJECT_NO WHERE VBB.BALANCE_DATE = #{earlyDate} AND VBB.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} ORDER BY VBB.SUBJECT_LEVEL,VBB.SUBJECT_NO

SELECT VBBA.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, VBBA.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, VBSD.SUBJECT_NO as fsubjectId, VBBA.O_CCY as oCcy, VBBA.BAL_FLAG_BOOK_DATE as balFlag, VBBA.O_AMT_BOOK_DATE as oAmt FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_ALL VBBA INNER JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_DETAIL VBSD ON VBBA.BOOKSET_ID = VBSD.BOOKSET_ID AND VBBA.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE = VBSD.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE AND ABBA.BOK_DETAIL_ID = VBSD.BOK_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON VBBA.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT VBS ON C.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = VBS.BOOKSET_ID AND VBBA.SUBJECT_NO = VBS.SUBJECT_NO WHERE VBBA.BOOK_DATE = #{earlyDate} AND VBS.SUBJECT_TYPE = '03' AND VBBA.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}

SELECT VBBA.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, VBBA.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, VBSD.SUBJECT_NO as fsubjectId, VBBA.O_CCY as oCcy, VBBA.CD_FLAG as balFlag, SUM(NVL(VBBA.O_HAPPEN_AMT,0)) as oAmt FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_ALL VBBA INNER JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_DETAIL VBSD ON VBBA.BOOKSET_ID = VBSD.BOOKSET_ID AND VBBA.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE = VBSD.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE AND ABBA.BOK_DETAIL_ID = VBSD.BOK_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON VBBA.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT VBS ON C.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = VBS.BOOKSET_ID AND VBBA.SUBJECT_NO = VBS.SUBJECT_NO WHERE VBBA.BOOK_DATE > #{earlyDate} AND VBBA.BOOK_DATE <= #{endDate} AND VBBA.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND VBS.SUBJECT_TYPE = '03' GROUP BY VBBA.DETAIL_SUBJECT,VBBA.O_CCY as oCcy,VBBA.CD_FLAG as balFlag
